en.headline: Man attacked and robbed of HK$300,000 Rolex in Sheung Shui
en.dek: Five men armed with iron bars set upon a 36-year-old victim near Hak Pai Tsai Village late on Wednesday; the attackers fled in a private car and no arrests have been made.
body: A 36-year-old man was attacked and robbed of a Rolex watch valued at about HK$300,000 in Sheung Shui on Wednesday night. Police said the victim, surnamed Lee, was set upon by five men aged about 25 to 30 armed with iron bars at Hak Pai Tsai Village on Sha Tau Kok Road–Lung Yeuk Tau around 11:31 p.m.

The assailants stole the watch and fled in a private car. Lee suffered hand injuries and back pain and was taken conscious by ambulance to North District Hospital. Police classified the case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm and theft.
The case is being handled by the Tai Po District Crime Investigation Team 4. No arrests have been made. Police are seeking the five men and said the victim is understood not to know the suspects.

zh.headline: 上水男子遇襲被搶30萬元勞力士錶 五賊在逃
zh.dek: 36歲事主周三晚在沙頭角公路龍躍頭段黑排仔村遭五名男子持鐵通襲擊，勞力士錶被掠走，事主手部受傷及腰痛送院。
body: 上水周三晚發生傷人及盜竊案。一名36歲李姓男子約11時31分在沙頭角公路－龍躍頭段黑排仔村，突遭五名約25至30歲男子持鐵通襲擊，並被掠走一隻約值30萬元的勞力士手錶。賊人其後登上私家車逃去。
事主手部受傷及腰痛，清醒由救護車送往北區醫院治理。警方將案件列作襲擊致造成身體傷害及盜竊，交由大埔警區刑事調查隊第四隊跟進。
暫未有人被捕。警方正追查五名涉案男子下落，據了解事主與涉案男子互不認識。
